approved: Three bills—Statute Law Revision (Spring 2016) Bill 2016, Statute Update Bill 2016, and Corporations Amendment (Auditor Registration) Bill 2016—were referred to the Federation Chamber for further consideration upon adjournment of debate.

Labor supports the Corporations Amendment (Auditor Registration) Bill 2016, arguing it was previously trampled by the Prime Minister’s rush to an election, and questioned when a joint sitting would follow the double dissolution.
